items.why: Slackbot, previously listed with generic plan limits, now shows a 15 messages per user each week cap on Business+ and is unlimited on Enterprise+.

record.short: Slackbot on Business+ is now capped at 15 messages per user each week; Enterprise+ is unlimited.
record.headline: Slack put an explicit weekly message cap on Slackbot for Business+ users and marked Enterprise+ as unlimited, replacing the vague “plan limits apply” wording.
record.who: Business+ customers using Slackbot face a stated cap; Enterprise+ customers are unlimited. Pricing page does not say whether existing customers are affected differently.
record.read: Slack is turning Slackbot into a metered AI feature and using the cap to separate Business+ from Enterprise+. Extra capacity is sold through sales, which suggests a future paid usage add-on.
record.caveat: The page also lists a consumption-based usage limits row in the feature comparison; its exact terms are not shown. Company explanation not found.

items.why: Only the NEW badges next to existing features were removed; no price, plan or limit changed.
Daily Yield rate drift (3.48% → 3.47% etc.), a rotating banner and a footnote date changed; a minor ERP integration bullet was dropped from the Enterprise list with no pricing impact.
Only a demo-booking popup block disappeared in one variant; no pricing content changed.
